texts.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]。我们得知，你们的帝国收留了一位天才。[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetName]的天才在[Root.GetName]有点大材小用了，而我们[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName]的各项活动一向需要经验丰富的科学家。因此，我们特为你们提供一个绝佳的机会，只要将[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]借给我们，就能赢得我们的好感。我们已派出了一只飞船接应[FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]，你只需要说一声“是”，就算万事俱备了。

你们应该会同意的……对吧？
texts.en:
[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. We understand that your empire is home to an individual whose brilliant mind transcends the tragic primitiveness of your species. While the talents of [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetName] are sadly wasted in the [Root.GetName], we [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetSpeciesName] always have a use for skilled scientists to work in our archives. As such, we are offering you a unique chance to earn our favor by allowing us to take charge of [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer]. We already have a ship en route to pick [FallenEmpireScientistTarget.GetHimHer] up, so you need only say "yes" and everything will be settled.

I'm sure you won't want to disappoint us... do you?

tooltips.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]会很满意的，也许还会在未来对我们加以青睐。
tooltips.en: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] will be pleased, and may show us favor in the future.

label.en: We will never give one our own to alien hands!
It is not up to us to decide!

label.zh: 将我们最聪慧的人才拱手相送？还是免了。
label.en: Give up our brightest mind? I think not.

# 来自[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]的通讯 / Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/fallen_empire_tasks_events.txt:1847-2020; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:601 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

唯物堕落帝国“索要科学家”：五年随机脉冲（on_five_year_random_pulse_country_fe_list，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:595-614）把本任务作为候选；各候选权重相对980，抽中后仍须通过其触发条件。（权重50。）条件：非AI默认国家，人口多于1000，非集群，不在战争中，没问过（fe_materialist_asked_scientist），拥有技能高于4且不在探索星门的科学家，且有狂热唯物的堕落帝国与我方有通讯并“庇护”或“轻视”我方。

A materialist fallen empire "asks for a scientist": The five-year random pulse (on_five_year_random_pulse_country_fe_list, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:595-614) lists this task among its candidates; weights are out of 980 and the event's own trigger must still pass. (weight 50.) Conditions: a human default country with over 1000 pops, non-gestalt, not at war, never asked (fe_materialist_asked_scientist), owning a scientist with base skill above 4 not exploring an astral rift, and a fanatic-materialist fallen empire in contact that is patronizing or dismissive.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

fallen_empires_tasks.22：对方要求交出这位科学家。a 同意（科学家被带走，对方好感）；b/c/d/e 为拒绝的不同措辞（依伦理），对方不悦。

fallen_empires_tasks.22: the empire asks for that scientist. a agrees (the scientist is taken, the empire is pleased); b/c/d/e are differently worded refusals (by ethics) and displease it.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

同意与四种拒绝互斥。

Agreeing and the four refusals are exclusive.
